job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
job.acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2020 Santa Barbara County Employees’ Retirement System RFP for discretionary private equity consultant services, not the OPERS investment consulting services RFP. Its submission deadline does not support the requested OPERS deadline.
quotes: SANTA BARBARA COUNTY EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP) FOR DISCRETIONARY PRIVATE EQUITY CONSULTANT SERVICES
The deadline for submission of the proposal is 5:00 pm PST, August 21, 2020.
